subject: SIG response: Admin trail export formats & delivery timeline
messages:
From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@helixcare.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: sig@thirdpartyaudit.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG v2024: admin trail request (12mo)

Hi Vivek,

We're working through HelixCare's SIG responses and need a deliverable for the admin trail portion. The security team asked for the following for the past 12 months:
- All admin console actions (role/permission changes, API key creation/revocation, policy updates, org settings, dedicated node assignments)
- Deployment and model-change events (model version, quantization toggles, routing changes)
- Authentication events for console and API (successful/failed logins, MFA changes)
- Admin-originated exports and delegation events

Can you confirm: 1) which exact fields you include per event (actor id/email, actor role, timestamp, ip, request_id, before/after payload where applicable), 2) available export formats (CSV, JSONL/NDJSON, Parquet), 3) delivery methods (pre-signed S3, direct SFTP, BigQuery load), and 4) expected turnaround for a one-off 12-month export?

Also circle back on cryptographic verification (manifest + hash) and whether you can provide a chain-of-custody statement for the bundle.

Thanks — Maria
Security Program Manager
HelixCare
(attachment: SIG_scope_helixcare.pdf)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@helixcare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v2024: admin trail request (12mo)

Maria — thanks for the clear list. High level answers up front, details and attachments below.

What we log (admin trail scope)
- Actor metadata: actor_email, actor_id (internal UUID), primary_role (console vs service account), geo_ip, source_ip
- Action metadata: event_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, correlation_id, client_agent
- Payload snapshots: before/after when the event modified config (policy changes, role edits, key rotations)
- Auth events: success/failure, challenge_type (PW/MFA/SSO), identity_provider
- Deployment events: model_id, model_version, runtime_flags (quantization, batch size), routing_policy_id
- Export/audit actions: exported_by, export_scope, export_format, export_destination

Retention and storage
- Default retained in-system: 365 days (rolling).
- For hosted customers requesting an export we can package historical data beyond 365d if the backstore snapshot is available; Dedicated/Private customers commonly retain longer per contract.

Export formats and delivery options
- Formats: NDJSON (preferred), CSV (flattened), Parquet (columnar), compressed tar.gz bundles.
- Delivery: pre-signed S3 PUT to customer's bucket (preferred), direct SFTP drop, one-time BigQuery load, or secure ShareFile link with expiration.
- Integrity: we produce a SHA256 manifest and a GPG-signed manifest file. For S3 deliveries we also provide a signed URL and a manifest hash (sha256_manifest.txt).

Turnaround and sizing
- Typical one-off 12mo export for a mid-sized tenancy (50k admin events) = 48–72 hours for collection + packaging and verification. Larger footprints scale linearly; we can parallelize if you need a faster SLA.

Attached: sig_export_spec_v1.pdf (fields + sample payloads), sample_field_map.csv (CSV header mapping).

Next steps / ask from HelixCare
1) Confirm exact time window (UTC) and whether you want redaction of IP addresses/subject fields.
2) Confirm preferred delivery (S3 vs SFTP) and destination details.
3) Tell us if you need the signed manifest to be notarized by your auditor and whether GPG or an HSM-signed envelope is required.

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

— Vivek
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
(attachment: sig_export_spec_v1.pdf; attachment: sample_field_map.csv)

Vivek / Redwood team — quick follow-ups from our side:
- We require end-to-end integrity verification. Can you include a manifest with SHA256 hashes for each file and a detached GPG signature?
- For forensic completeness, we need before/after snapshots for config changes. Are you able to include the delta payloads for role/permission edits and policy updates?
- Please confirm whether timestamps are stored in UTC and the timestamp precision (seconds vs milliseconds vs nanoseconds).
- Do logs include the pre-rotation API key identifier (masked) and the post-rotation key id? If yes, are secret values ever present in the export?

Finally, please provide a short statement we can include in the SIG response describing chain-of-custody for exported bundles (who prepared it, when, delivery method, cryptographic verification).

Thanks — SIG team
(attachment: audit_requirements_checklist.docx)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: sig@thirdpartyaudit.com, Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@helixcare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v2024: admin trail request (12mo)

Thanks — answering point-by-point below.

Integrity + chain-of-custody
- We produce a per-bundle sha256_manifest.txt listing each filename and its SHA256. The manifest is GPG detached-signed by our compliance key. We can optionally have the bundle notarized via a partner HSM for an extra attestation.
- Delivery artifacts include: packaging agent (employee id), packaging timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC), packaging node id, packaging git-hash (export tool version).

Payloads and secrets
- We include before/after snapshots for config changes where applicable; payloads show diffs but we do not emit secret values. API secrets and private keys are never exported in plaintext. For API key rotations the export contains key_id_pre (masked, last 4 chars) and key_id_post (masked).

Timestamps and precision
- All timestamps in exports are ISO 8601 in UTC (e.g., 2026-11-03T18:22:13.123456Z). We include microsecond precision; nano precision available on request.

Example fields included (sample row for an event)
- event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_email, actor_internal_id, actor_role, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, correlation_id, source_ip_masked, geo_country, before_payload_base64, after_payload_base64, export_bundle_id

Operational notes
- For the HelixCare export we recommend NDJSON compressed into tar.gz. That preserves payloads and is easy to stream into BigQuery or S3.
- Estimated SLA: 48 hours after signed export agreement + destination details.

I've attached the export spec and a sample manifest (sha256_manifest.txt). Laura and Monica are copied for ops coordination; they'll handle the export job and delivery once HelixCare confirms preferences.

Deliverable checklist we will provide:
- Data bundle (ndjson.tar.gz)
- sha256_manifest.txt + manifest.sig (GPG)
- chain_of_custody.txt (short statement)
- sample_field_map.csv

If that all works for you, Maria, can you confirm the exact UTC window and whether you need IP addresses fully redacted or masked? Also confirm S3 bucket + prefix or SFTP creds (we prefer pre-signed S3).

— Vivek
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
(attachments: sha256_manifest.txt; chain_of_custody.txt)
